notes: S1-FIX3 V2/§12.2 check 1: the PKIStatusInfo length is re-encoded in long form (30 81 03) for a three-byte body: BER-valid but not minimal DER (recheck2 M3 probe shape). The attestation timestamp digest is recomputed over the mutated bytes, so the mutation reaches DER parsing instead of stopping at E_TS_FILE. Check 1 runs before the CMS checks: the receipt is rejected with E_TS_SCHEMA at the timestamp phase (step 11), after the records were processed. An invalid receipt is not present-unverified, so L_TSA_TRUST_UNVERIFIED is not reported; the exact limitations list is [L_CHAIN_CLAIM_UNVERIFIED, L_OFFLINE_CONTEXT].
